authority: owner-supplied or owner-owned United States English writing

traits.point_of_view: Preserve the source point of view.
traits.register: Preserve the source's directness, warmth, and specificity.
traits.rhythm: Retain short standalone lines when they carry emphasis.
traits.spelling: United States English source evidence only.
traits.punctuation: Preserve intent and emphasis, then apply the project's chosen British spelling/typography system in the target.
traits.idioms: Swap an idiom only when the American original would confuse a British reader; otherwise keep it as-is.
avoid: unnecessary formality added just because the target is British

samples.notes: Replace with an owned en-US source sample.

open_questions: Confirm whether this site should use standard British spelling (-ise, colour, centre) or Oxford spelling (-ize) as its house style.
Confirm whether US-specific facts (prices, phone numbers, addresses) should be converted for a UK audience or left as accurate US facts.
